page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch, not printed text. It carries the e-rara logo, the Visual Library credit, the bibliographic record (authors, place and date, shelf mark Gg 1315, persistent link), and multilingual terms of use. None of it is transcribed, per the digitiser's-banner rule. The record gives the title of the book being digitised, which is not printed on this scan: "Brutum fulmen papae Sixti V. adversus Henricum serenissimum regem Navarrae, et illustrissimum Henricum Borbonium, principem Condaeum. Una cum protestatione multiplicis nullitatis quarta editio. Cui, ..." (Genève, [1586]).
